about: The coverage checks of publish/raw_issues.py. Each one opens an issue [raw] <topic>: <check> while its condition holds, and closes it when the condition no longer holds. A change of a value here is a change of what the research repository is asked to do.

kinds.examples: OneSignal, Firebase Cloud Messaging, ntfy, Pushover, Gotify
Doppler, Infisical, Bitwarden Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault (HCP)
